summary.en: Installer and manager for the Animal Crossing: New Horizons in-game agent.
summary.zh: 《集合啦!动物森友会》游戏内 agent 的安装与管理工具。

details.en:
ACNH-Manager installs and updates the acnh-agent files (atmosphere/contents/01006F8002326000/exefs) for Animal Crossing: New Horizons, and can uninstall them again.

It detects which game build is installed (title version + update content id, plus the running main module id when the game is open), refuses builds it does not support, verifies every file with SHA-256 before writing, and keeps an install record so one tap rolls everything back.

Current support: ACNH 3.0.3 only. The agent itself is fail-closed: on an unknown build it installs nothing and does nothing in-game.
details.zh:
ACNH-Manager 负责安装与更新《集合啦!动物森友会》的 acnh-agent 文件(atmosphere/contents/01006F8002326000/exefs),并支持一键卸载回滚。

它会识别当前安装的是哪个游戏构建(标题版本号 + 更新包内容 id,游戏运行时还会读运行中的 main 模块 id),不支持的构建一律拒绝;写入前逐文件校验 SHA-256,并保留安装记录以便回滚。

当前支持:仅 ACNH 3.0.3。agent 自身是 fail-closed 的:遇到不认识的构建不写任何数据、游戏内也不做任何事。

changelog.en: 0.1.0 - first public build: environment detection (game version, update content id, running module id), install/uninstall with per-file SHA-256 verification and one-tap rollback, offline install from the agent copy bundled in the app, in-app update check, Chinese/English interface.
changelog.zh: 0.1.0 - 首个公开版本:环境识别(游戏版本、更新包内容 id、运行中的模块 id)、逐文件 SHA-256 校验的安装/卸载与一键回滚、内置 agent 副本离线安装、应用内检查更新、中英双语界面。
